meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会具备把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 的能力。它会在自己的运行环境里装好 Vercel 的发布工具,并向你要一次 Vercel 个人访问令牌用于保存,之后你能让它执行部署、查看部署列表等。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 的生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会把当前项目发布到 Vercel 生产环境。

say.text: 列出我在 Vercel 上的所有部署记录。
say.note: Claude 会获取并显示部署列表。

say.text: 帮我确认一下 Vercel 登录是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会验证 Vercel 登录是否正常。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel. It installs the Vercel CLI in its environment and saves your Vercel personal token (provided once), after which you can ask Claude to run a deployment or list existing deployments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to deploy a web app to Vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude will deploy it to Vercel production.

say_en.text: List all my deployments on Vercel.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and show your deployment list.

say_en.text: Check whether my Vercel login is working.
say_en.note: Claude will verify your Vercel credentials.
